critical_code_review_comments: routers/fzr_orders.py:44 PATCH /admin/fazercards/settings uses admin=Depends(require_super_admin) directly (not dependencies=), which is correct because it reads admin['user_id']; but GET uses dependencies=[require_admin]. Pattern is inconsistent — consider harmonizing.

routers/fzr_orders.py:100 fzr_catalog_refresh mutates fazercards._catalog_cache (module-level dict) directly. If catalog fetch fails midway the cache stays cleared. Consider clearing only after successful pubg_catalog() call.

test_fzr_phase3.py:22 sets a shared asyncio loop and multiple tests reassign it. With xdist workers this pattern is fragile — currently passing but could regress silently if new async fixtures are added.
